name: @financial-analysis/api
description: Cloudflare Workers API with MCP server for financial analysis

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/analysis run build && pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/capabilities run build && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs --exclude src/__tests__/api-endpoints.test.ts
scripts.test:api:endpoints: pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/analysis run build && pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/capabilities run build && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs src/__tests__/api-endpoints.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/analysis run build && pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/capabilities run build && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs src/__tests__/health-headers.test.ts src/__tests__/ping-version.test.ts src/__tests__/openapi.test.ts src/__tests__/openapi-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/openapi-snapshot.test.ts
scripts.test:chat:integration: pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/analysis run build && pnpm --filter @financial-analysis/capabilities run build && RUN_AI_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs src/__tests__/chat-integration.test.ts
